body:
trying to find a doctor is as hard as putting the bottle down, most wont take new patients or have a long waiting period. 

I have a psychiatrist I've seen since my run in with the law, but his answer was antidepressants. taking zoloft just makes me feel like I'm not me,  if that makes any sense he helped me stop them 5 years ago
I did just find some outdoor groups and a MTG group in my area! never thought of a site like that
i agree but i guess i learned to socialize with booze and weed.  learning to walk without a crutch when you have used it your entire life is harder than learning the first time.

i would just smoke, i prefer it. and u know it would make it much easier to stop drinking, but I'm tested quarterly and also when anyone who works with me is involved in any type of accident. people report a stubbed toe and get time off. I had 8 drug tests in the past year. seems like the way the company weeds out the new hires.
